terms.comment: A queen in her own right, as Cleopatra, or a king’s wife (Lewis & Short). In comedy also a fine lady, against the maids (Plaut., Ter.), and in the poets a king’s daughter (see princess). Also the queen in cards and in chess (Traupman 51–52).

phrases.english: too deep for words, my queen, is the grief you bid me live again
